extraction_notes: MM3Z5V1 is the 0A-marked row in the five-page MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 family datasheet.
The nominal zener voltage is 5.1 V at IZT = 5 mA; the same row gives a 4.8 V minimum and 5.4 V maximum range.
The forward-voltage entry is a maximum-rated value of 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA from p. 1, not a typical forward-IV point.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time value and no tabulated capacitance value for this part.
The characteristic plots on pp. 3-4 are family-level plots without an MM3Z5V1-specific trace or numeric point labels, so curve points were not extracted rather than interpolated.
omission_reason: The datasheet characteristic plots are aggregate family curves without an MM3Z5V1-specific trace or numeric point labels; extracting points for this part would require interpolation, so no usable curves were recorded.
